module.purpose: Defines thenable types matching React's internal promise shape and helpers to create pending thenables and synchronously detect resolved data for suspense/optimistic rendering.
module.summary: This module provides TypeScript interfaces and type aliases that model React's internal thenable representation, where a promise carries status, value, or reason properties. It exports a factory that builds a pending thenable with attached resolve and reject methods that transition the object and clean up pending props, plus a utility that tries to synchronously extract a resolved value from a promise without relying on React's non-public status fields. It relies on a noop helper to ignore rejections safely.
module.businessContext: Supports React Query core suspense and concurrent rendering. Failure breaks async data unwrapping and causes unhandled rejection errors.
classes: Fulfilled (~L12-15): Interface for fulfilled thenable with status and value
Rejected (~L16-19): Interface for rejected thenable with status and reason
Pending (~L20-33): Interface for pending thenable with resolve/reject callbacks
functions: pendingThenable (~L44-84): Creates a pending thenable with attached resolve/reject
finalize (~L58-64): Merges result into thenable and clears pending props
tryResolveSync (~L94-111): Attempts synchronous extraction of promise result

detail.name: pendingThenable
postconditions: Returns a thenable object with status 'pending' and resolve/reject methods attached
The returned thenable has a catch handler that prevents unhandled rejection errors
invariants: After resolve or reject is called, the corresponding method is deleted from the thenable to prevent double finalization
edgeCases: Calling resolve(value) assigns status 'fulfilled' and value, then invokes underlying Promise resolve
Calling reject(reason) assigns status 'rejected' and reason, then invokes underlying Promise reject
Rejection is caught internally so no unhandled rejection is surfaced
stateMutations: On finalize, Object.assigns status/value/reason onto thenable and deletes resolve/reject properties
detail.summary: Creates a pending thenable with attached resolve/reject methods that transition it to fulfilled/rejected status and swallows rejections to avoid unhandled errors.

units.name: tryResolveSync

detail.name: tryResolveSync
preconditions: Argument must be a Promise or Thenable exposing a `then` method.
postconditions: If the thenable invoked its onFulfilled callback synchronously, returns an object { data } containing the resolved value.
If the thenable did not resolve synchronously or rejected, returns undefined.
edgeCases: Synchronously resolving thenable: onFulfilled runs immediately, data is set, function returns { data }.
Pending native Promise: then callback deferred, data remains undefined, returns undefined.
Rejected promise/thenable: onRejected noop is called, data stays undefined, returns undefined.
Thenable without a `.catch` method: optional chaining `?.catch` skips the call, no error is thrown.

raises: TypeError if argument lacks a `then` method

stateMutations: Local variable `data` is assigned inside the then callback (function-local only).
detail.summary: Synchronously attempts to read a resolved value from a promise or thenable; returns { data } only if resolution happened synchronously during the call, otherwise returns undefined.
